bodyText: ABOUT WORK SERVICES CONTACT Armab Agency We build strategic brands and digital experiences that help ambitious businesses grow, compete, and stand out. WORK WITH US ABOUT US Armab is a founder-led strategic digital agency removing the roadblocks to your brand growth. We help ambitious teams turn complex ideas and platforms into clear digital experiences that bring calmness, structure, and trust. Led by two strategic partners No corporate layers, no junior handoff Removing the roadblocks to your brand growth No separation between craftmanship and design Our Work Fuhsi Market Fuhsi Market is a campus marketplace built to make student trading safer and simpler. It brings trusted listings, protected payments, seller payouts and campus handovers into one clear experience for buyers and sellers. VIEW PROJECT → Billet Design Billet Design makes machined mechanical keyboards built for people who do serious work at their desks. Every board is cut from a single block of aluminium and finished by hand until the light sits flat across the case and the sound lands where it should. Three layouts, one mounting system, and every board ships as a kit you can keep re-tuning. VIEW PROJECT → Kitty We created the proposition, identity and product direction for a familiar idea reimagined for a cashless world. A digital pot for shared experiences. Kitty gives groups of friends a simple way to contribute to one shared pot, keeping money from getting in the way of the occasion. VIEW PROJECT → Opus Bringing everything that defines a brand into one intelligent platform. The system analyses and develops this knowledge over time, helping teams create bespoke assets with greater speed and consistency. We developed the identity and product experience, translating a complex brand system into an accessible creative tool. VIEW PROJECT → VIEW ALL WORK Our Services 01 Digital-First Branding STRATEGY Digital-First Branding DESIGN We build brands born for the screen — positioning, identity and digital expression engineered to lead online from day one. 02 Brand Strategy VOICE Brand Strategy LANGUAGE We help teams align on direction, define their proposition and move from ambiguity to a clear point of view stakeholders can understand and act on. 03 UX/UI Design FLOW UX/UI Design AESTHETIC We create identities, design systems and product experiences that make organisations feel credible, distinctive and ready for market. 04 Web Design & Development PERFORMANCE Web Design & Development ARCHITECTURE We design and build propositions, workflows and interfaces that make complex digital products feel clear, intuitive and genuinely useful. 05 3D / Motion DEPTH 3D / Motion TEXTURE We add dimension and movement to brands with 3D, motion and interaction design — work that feels considered, premium and alive. WORK WITH US New Agency Not new to this Engineered for Growth Removing the roadblocks holding your business back. We build digital products from the ground up, turning complex business hurdles into high-converting systems engineered for long-term scalability. Custom Technical Craft Zero generic templates. Zero bloated frameworks. Every single line of code is meticulously handwritten. We merge crisp web design with robust engineering to ensure your platform runs clean and fast. Direct Founder Partnership The partners you meet are the architects doing the work. From initial brand strategy to final code deployment, you work directly with our two senior strategic founders. No junior handoffs, ever. Full-Stack Execution Senior strategy, design, and web development under one roof. We eliminate the friction of managing separate agencies. We take your project fluidly from abstract positioning strategy straight into high-performance web development. Built for Clarity Bringing absolute calmness and structure to your digital presence. We strip away traditional corporate agency layers. We operate close to the details, making fast design and deployment decisions to keep your momentum steady. Deep Focus. Elite Attention. Small by design, massive in impact. We intentionally restrict our client roster to a select few engagements. This guarantees our founders give your business their complete, uncompromised focus.
